# PKG-GIFT-OPEN — Framing (frozen)

```text
shot_id:            PKG-GIFT-OPEN
frozen:             2026-08-12
applies_to:         golden-jiuzhou
```

## Subject

Single SKU in **open-box state**. Lid lifted or removed. The
interior is the focus; the product, the inner tray, or a
message card is visible.

## Framing

- Open lid revealed.
- Interior product / message / micro-detail visible.
- Brand mark on the **lid** (visible even when the box is open).

## Aspect ratio

Preferred `4:3` (landscape). `3:2` acceptable.

## Lighting

- Key from above-front to enhance the reveal.
- Soft fill from inside the box if possible (to show the
  interior without harsh shadow).
- Reveals the interior depth and any inner-tray detail.

## Physical logic (PKG-F10)

- Lid hinge / magnet / ribbon behavior must be physically
  plausible.
- No floating lid.
- No lid that "magically" stays mid-air.
- No product that appears to be levitating.

## Reference fidelity

- Inner tray material matches the Locked Asset substrate.
- Color ratio inside the box respects the Golden baseline
  (interior may be calmer than exterior, but still in ratio).

## Axis weight

- Composition Quality carries additional weight: PKG-F10 fires
  on physical-logic failure.
